risks.note: Listed as a threat in the Company's own SWOT analysis. The Products and Solutions businesses sell largely into Telecom PSUs, Government, Public Sector, Railways, Defence and state networks (Pondicherry SWAN, BSNL-WCL, BSNL-BCCL, RailTel-WCL, APEPDCL), so revenue is tied to public tendering, budget cycles and policy continuity.
Listed as a threat in the SWOT analysis; customer liquidity constraints stretch collections and working capital in a tender-driven, project-based business.

Listed as a weakness in the SWOT analysis. Product engineering, firmware and network integration depend on scarce specialist talent, which is why management says the coming year's focus will be greater hiring.
Listed as a weakness in the SWOT analysis; expensive funding weighs on a business that must fund R&D, inventory and project execution as well as real estate development.
Management itself flags R&D as a weakness even while new products (1G indigenous switch, NOS, UTM, SD-WAN) are the stated growth engine, so under-investment directly threatens the product roadmap.
The Company notes it maintained product sales 'despite increased market competition and various challenges', indicating competitive pressure on the switching and routing business.
risks.risk: Increased market competition in networking products

risks.note: Solutions revenue declined because projects were in the renewal and contract renegotiation stage during the year, showing that recurring O&M revenue is exposed to re-tendering and repricing at contract expiry.
risks.risk: Contract renewal and renegotiation risk in the Solutions business

risks.note: Market acceptance rests on TEC certification, clearing RDSO inspection and remaining a Trusted Source on the DoT Trusted Portal, plus compliance with the National Security Directive on the Telecommunication Sector; loss or non-renewal of any of these would restrict access to the Company's core public-sector markets.
risks.risk: Dependence on certifications and trusted-source status for market access
